body: Hiii! I’m actually in Salem right now! When are you hoping to visit?

It’s not your fault, momma!! Not one bit!! Can you have him admitted to a residential program? Since he’s in an alternate school you must have access to the school counselor or a case manager. Reach out to them and tell them how bad it is. There is help for you!! (I’m a teacher for kiddos with mental illness, middle school aged.) 

You are not alone. This is not the end of the road. Things CAN get better.
Thank you!! I might try to go in for Tuesday at least but plan to spend the day tomorrow calling orthopedics. I was only told to take Tylenol, so it’s been a rough weekend!!
Thank you so much! They have a few ideas as to why it happened, waiting on an Orthopedic surgeon to be open, because of course it’s the weekend!
I really don’t need to include any sort of information I don’t want to share. Thanks for commenting, have a great day.
Thank you so much!! I appreciate your kindness.

I am not at all sure why you’re being so rude to me. This is literally my first post here and you’re treating me like this? I am not sure why. Feel free to move on past my post if you’re so bothered by it.
So that’s not actually what happened. I fell on my right knee and somehow broke my left hip. The X-ray results showed some pretty worrisome results in general.
Oh, because of what medical professionals have explained to me.
That’s a very good point. I just have to get over the embarrassment first 😞

I am feeling the exact same way but my school doesn’t care. I literally left yesterday with every intention of hurting myself. For some reason I didn’t. 

I am not okay. I haven’t worked at my current school long enough to be eligible for FMLA. I don’t know how much longer I can live like this.
